principles: Do not download or duplicate source images from Vocus or Canva until license/reuse and author approval are documented.
Do not substitute entire text-based IG carousel cards as article cover images.
Skip redundant Podcast promotion graphics; use already verified episode/Spotify/Apple buttons.
Keep informative visuals at their source_article_positions if author and rights approval become available.
Never infer image ownership from hosting domain or source caption.
